pwsbuilder October 11, 2018

You’re Invited!
Artists Wine and Cheese Reception, Tuesday, October 16, 4:00 PM – 6:00 PM at The 400 East Restaurant

Member artists of The Art Gallery of The Guild of Harwich Artists, Harwich Port, have their original art and photographic images printed on large canvases on exhibit and for sale at The 400 East. Also exhibited are original acrylic pours on canvas by Lee Ames and original oil on linen canvases by Janet Whittemore.
